candidates.name: contrastive_retrieval
candidates.hypothesis: On the configured validation split, IDF-weighted retrieval with label-diverse MMR selection will exceed fewshot_all's 80% accuracy using at most five demonstrations.

candidates.name: class_evidence_profiles
candidates.hypothesis: On the configured validation split, replacing raw demonstrations with learned class evidence profiles will reach at least 80% accuracy while reducing injected context length by at least 30%.

candidates.name: hypothesis_grouped
candidates.hypothesis: On the configured validation split, grouping all labeled cases by label and prompting explicit support-versus-conflict comparison will exceed 80% accuracy while keeping injected context at or below fewshot_all's 8400 characters.
